control_profile: Controls off: unchanged baseline targets with no volatility scaling, drawdown brake, position stop, time stop, or turnover throttle.
falsifier: If removing all optional controls improves robust edge after costs and across folds, the baseline control stack is suppressing signal rather than limiting its stated risks.
hypothesis: A controls-off replay isolates raw slow-trend behavior and measures whether risk scaling and exit controls improve or merely cosmetically smooth the baseline.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first UTC decision boundary
